input.sourceAttribution: Piano Protege Curriculum by Riya Ranjan, Sabbagh, De (CS224R project)
input.referenceQuality: Contributor-hand-authored; no blinded independent pianist consensus
input.originalInput: Hand-labelled PIG text at pinned SHA-256; temporary piano SMF generated 60 BPM 9600 PPQ, exact MIDI bytes shared across actual Python repeats, verified raw note-on/off event mapping
input.noteTiming: Quantized to ticks of 1/9600 s; not a claim of original MIDI/MusicXML bit parity
input.fg02i: existing research-only score router, handSize M, beamWidth 40

interpretation.note: Hands were supplied from annotated source to both engines: this is a finger-choice comparison, not a blind hand-separation test. Exact-match of one annotation is not the unique viable piano fingering. Python wall time includes interpreter startup, JS is in-process: cannot compare speed from reported times. No algorithm weights changed.
interpretation.next: Independent blind pianist-labelled polyphonic and varied-hand-size held-out corpus; preregister metrics and prevent tuning on evaluation cohort.
